# Pinned engines from the supplied 3D Bowl V6 reference

These files are bundled only for the optional local 3D Bowl mode. They are
loaded on demand, use no CDN at runtime, and do not change the Arcade engine.

- Three.js **0.180.0**: `three.module.min.js`, `three.core.min.js`.
  Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz
  License: `THREE-LICENSE.txt` (MIT).
- cannon-es **0.20.0**: `cannon-es.mjs` (upstream `dist/cannon-es.js`, unchanged).
  Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/cannon-es/-/cannon-es-0.20.0.tgz
  License: `CANNON-LICENSE.txt` (MIT).

No install scripts or package manager dependencies are needed by the cabinet.
